decision_rule.quality: Require every frozen useful-task and declared lifecycle gate; no per-task regression, plus a quality improvement or the predeclared efficiency tie rule
decision_rule.efficiency_tie: At least5 percent lower paired median native gross input-plus-output tokens, complete counters and no greater paired median agent time
decision_rule.fallback: Keep the measured Dagu baseline; source fixtures on different semantics cannot produce a comparative scheduler win
